replacements.reason: The original global stores the target C library's private PowerPC jump-buffer representation and ABI padding. Native execution instead stores the host C library's public jmp_buf type; the object is translation-unit-local in use and only carries the nonlocal animation-search return context.
C jmp_buf is an array type and decays to the pointer expected by the host longjmp declaration. Exact GALE01 assembly passes the jump-buffer address and value one, which this host-C call preserves.

The decomp names the target C library's private __setjmp entry point. Public host setjmp establishes the same nonlocal-return checkpoint using the matching native jmp_buf representation; exact GALE01 control flow tests its zero result before traversing animation objects.

The animation type mask is computed before setjmp, consumed only on the initial traversal call, and never read after longjmp. Volatile gives the host compiler the required nonlocal-jump storage contract without changing the mask calculation, traversal arguments, or post-jump result.

Port all twelve stage animation callback argument modes through the exact typed dispatch already implemented by pinned aobj.c callbackForeachFunc. The prior Event() casts omit required arguments and corrupt object identity on native stack ABIs; floating and pointer modes also require their declared layouts. Remove superseded four approximate typedefs.
